problems.condition: Grammar Practice 6, упр. 6, с. 51. Диалоги в Present Continuous.
steps: Is the gardener watering the flowers? — No, he isn't. He's planting flowers. Is the boy reading? — No, he isn't. He's writing. Are the girls dancing? — No, they aren't. They're singing.
problems.answer: Is … -ing? — No, … isn't. … is …-ing.

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 6, упр. 7, с. 52. Исправь предложения по картинке.
steps: Andy isn't typing a letter. He's talking on the phone. Mary isn't sleeping. She's reading. The children aren't playing. They're eating.
problems.answer: … isn't …-ing. … is …-ing.

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 6, упр. 8, с. 52. Переведи фразы.
steps: to have breakfast in the kitchen, to have lunch at school, to go to school, to get up at seven, to watch TV in the evening, to go to bed at ten.
problems.answer: have breakfast, have lunch, go to school, get up, watch TV, go to bed

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 6, упр. 9, с. 52. Переведи предложения.
steps: My brother always reads in the evening and I watch TV. My mother is cooking dinner now. We usually have lunch at one. What are you doing? — I'm doing my homework.
problems.answer: перевод 4–5 предложений

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 6, упр. 10, с. 52. Переведи ситуации.
steps: Look at this picture! What are the people doing? — This is a pilot. He is flying a plane. This is a doctor. She is helping a patient. This is a teacher. He is teaching children.
problems.answer: This is a … He / She is …-ing.

problems.condition: Module 7a «Year after year», упр. 1, с. 53. a) Расшифруй месяцы и времена года; b) соедини картинки с сезонами.
steps: a) March, April, May — spring. December, January, February — winter. June, July, August — summer. September, October, November — autumn.
problems.answer: spring, winter, summer, autumn; B, D, A, C

problems.condition: Module 7a, упр. 2, с. 53. Выбери подходящее слово.
steps: pick, play, rake, go, shining, heavily, freezing, hot.
problems.answer: pick, play, rake, go, shining, heavily, freezing, hot

problems.condition: Module 7a, упр. 3, с. 53. Прочитай тексты и ответь.
steps: It's very warm in Lapland in June. It's hot and sunny in Australia in December.
problems.answer: Lapland — warm in June; Australia — hot in December

problems.condition: Module 7b «Dress right!», упр. 1, с. 54. Что покупают Анна и Том?
steps: Anna: shoes, a jumper, a skirt, gloves. Tom: a scarf, trousers, a tie, a shirt.
problems.answer: Anna — shoes, jumper, skirt, gloves; Tom — scarf, trousers, tie, shirt

problems.condition: Module 7b, упр. 2, с. 54. Дополни схемы: одежда и аксессуары.
steps: Clothes: jumper, skirt, shirt, trousers, dress, coat, jeans. Accessories: shoes, gloves, scarf, tie, hat, handbag.
problems.answer: clothes / accessories

problems.condition: Module 7b, упр. 3, с. 54. a) Во что одеты люди; b) что на тебе сейчас и в разную погоду.
steps: a) Steve is wearing a grey suit and a tie. Bill is wearing school uniform — a blue jumper and black trousers. Ann is wearing a red dress and shoes.
b) I'm wearing blue jeans and a yellow jumper. When it's cold I wear a coat, a scarf and boots. When it's hot I wear shorts and a T-shirt.
problems.answer: … is wearing … I'm wearing …

problems.condition: Module 7b, упр. 4, с. 54. Составь вопросы и ответь.
steps: Are you picking flowers at the moment? — No, I'm not. Are you wearing a scarf and gloves? — Yes, I am. Have you got a raincoat? — Yes, I have. Does he swim well? — No, he doesn't. Is it raining? — No, it isn't.
problems.answer: Are you …-ing? Have you got …? Does he …?

problems.condition: Module 7b, упр. 5, с. 54. Вопросы и ответы: что делает сейчас и как часто.
steps: What is Paul doing? — He is doing his homework. How often does he do his homework? — Every afternoon. What is Mary doing? — She is walking the dog. How often does she walk the dog? — Every morning.
problems.answer: What is … doing? How often does …?

problems.condition: Module 7c «It's fun!», упр. 1, с. 55. Вопросы и ответы по фразам.
steps: Are they making a snowman? — No, they aren't. They are going camping. Is she watching TV? — No, she isn't. She is reading a book. Are they going camping? — No, they aren't. They are having a picnic.
problems.answer: Are they …-ing? — No, they aren't. They are …-ing.

problems.condition: Module 7c, упр. 2, с. 55. Выбери правильный ответ.
steps: a, b, b, a, a.
problems.answer: a, b, b, a, a

problems.condition: Module 7c, упр. 3, с. 55. Послушай и отметь ответ.
problems.answer: C, A, B

problems.condition: Module 7d «Writing (a postcard)», упр. 1, с. 56. Какая картинка соответствует открытке?
steps: Picture A.
problems.answer: A

problems.condition: Module 7d, упр. 2, с. 56. Напиши открытку с каникул.
steps: Dear Olga, I'm having a great time in Sochi. The sea is amazing. The weather is hot and sunny. My parents and I go swimming every day. Right now I'm sunbathing on the beach. See you soon! Anna.
problems.answer: I'm in … The weather is … I'm …-ing.

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 1, с. 57. Present Simple или Present Continuous.
steps: snows, is shining, is, wear, are wearing, makes, has, is swimming, is making.
problems.answer: snows, is shining, is, wear, are wearing, makes, has, is swimming, is making

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 2, с. 57. Вопросы с where, what, how, when.
steps: Where are the girls sitting? How does this dress look on me? What is he wearing? When do you go skiing?
problems.answer: Where / How / What / When …?

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 3, с. 57. Составь предложения из фраз.
steps: It is raining at the moment. We go to the swimming pool on Sundays. We go to Sochi in the summer. We always make lunch together. I am doing my homework right now. We wear warm clothes in winter.
problems.answer: at the moment / right now — Continuous; on Sundays / always — Simple

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 4, с. 57. Джеймс в лагере: обычно / сегодня.
steps: James usually eats a sandwich in the morning, but today he's eating cereal. He usually skateboards to school, but today he's walking to the camp. He usually plays computer games, but today he's playing football.
problems.answer: usually … but today he's …-ing

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 5, с. 58. Составь вопросы и ответь.
steps: What are you wearing right now? — A T-shirt and jeans. What is the weather like today? — It's cold and cloudy. What are your parents doing at the moment? — They are working. What do you usually do at weekends? — I play football.
problems.answer: What are you wearing? What's the weather like? What are … doing?

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 6, с. 58. Выбери верные слова.
steps: C, C, A, B, A, C, B.
problems.answer: C, C, A, B, A, C, B

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 7, с. 58. Исправь ошибки.
steps: Look! The little girl is making a snowman! We are looking for a T-shirt. Are Mary and Steve going home on foot today? Listen! It is raining. What size do you take? She never wears a hat.
problems.answer: is making, are looking, are going, is raining, do you take, wears

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 8, с. 58. Переведи слова и словосочетания.
steps: to swim, to pick flowers, to put on a coat, to be fed up with, to rake leaves, to go camping, a raincoat, a warm jumper.
problems.answer: swim, pick flowers, put on, fed up with, rake leaves

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 9, с. 58. Переведи предложения.
steps: It's warm and it's raining. It's hot. The sun is shining. It's wonderful outside. It's freezing. It's snowing and it's cold. What is the weather like in Scotland now? It's windy and cloudy.
problems.answer: It's raining / shining / freezing / snowing

problems.condition: Grammar Practice 7, упр. 10, с. 58. Переведи диалоги и ситуации.
steps: — Hi, Mary! It's Ann. What are you doing? — Hello. I'm reading an interesting book. — Let's go for a walk in the park. — OK. — Put on a warm coat. It's cold and windy.
problems.answer: What are you doing? — I'm reading. Let's go for a walk.

problems.condition: Module 8a «Celebrations», упр. 1, с. 59. Соотнеси слова в словосочетания и подпиши картинки.
steps: 1 — F, 2 — H, 3 — G, 4 — E, 5 — B, 6 — A, 7 — C, 8 — D. Pictures: A — street parade, B — set off fireworks, C — family dinner, D — exchange gifts.
problems.answer: F, H, G, E, B, A, C, D
